text.en:
Today you say which one you mean.
The person who called is here.
The man who repaired the roof is outside.
For a person, use who.
It tells which person.

A person: who.
A thing: that.
The shop that sells maps is closed.
The bus that stops here goes to the airport.
A place: where.
This is the cafe where we met.

You will say which one, in one sentence.
The book that I borrowed is on the desk.
That can go away.
The book I borrowed is on the desk.
The meaning stays the same.
